neighbours.label: the number (or 'sq') just before the second unit of a paired measurement, where the counterpart unit is due: '9 am to 6| pm', '8 km / 5| mi', '120 sq km (46 sq| mi)'; the output direction promotes ' pm'
fire: The bakery is open every day from 7 am to 4 pm except Mondays.
The lake lies 12 km / 7.5 mi north of the village.
The reserve covers 340 sq km (131 sq mi) of wetland.
Deliveries are accepted between 8 am and 3 pm at the side door.
The nearest station is 3 km / 1.9 mi from the hotel.
The county has an area of 2,150 sq km (830 sq mi) and two towns.
The pool is reserved for lessons from 10 am until 2 pm on Saturdays.
The loop walk is 6.4 km / 4 mi and takes about two hours.

notes: Card: digits and ' sq' right before ' mi' / ' pm' in km-mi and am-pm pairs, plus '_lb ... _ub' code pairs; output promotes ' pm', '_pm'. Probes: '9 am to 6 pm' 0.58, '8 km / 5 mi' 0.48, 'sq km (46 sq mi)' 0.58; a lone '6 pm' 0.11, lone '8 km' 0.002, plain counts 0.006. A lone 'Nov 14, 6 pm' is among the card's top examples, so the pairing is not strictly required.
